## Short answer

**It would have to fall to the LEFT, as we see it on screen** — i.e. sideways/broadside, straight across the paved apron and into the block of stacked shipping containers that sits beside it. In terms of the yard's layout, that means falling *away from the railway tracks*, roughly at right angles to them (with, if anything, a very slight lean "back and to the left", since the stacks sit a touch further from the camera than the machine does).
